prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering the onboarding flow (moving sign-in after adoption selection) was helpful (+5.5%).
Adding desktop ready background notification prompts was helpful (+5.1%).
Copy updates and quick hints (spawning instructions, account recovery warnings, overlay hints) showed no clear effect.
Waiting screen updates (progress indicators and tip carousels) showed no clear effect.
Layout tweaks and narrative redesigns showed no clear effect and can trigger guardrail rollbacks.
Predictions were mostly over-optimistic, though the notification prompt was slightly under-predicted (+4.0% vs +5.1%).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- choose_path, layout: +0.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: -2.2% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: -0.6% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: -0.4% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: +5.1% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +4.0% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: -0.3% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +5.5% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 82.9%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.0%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Split Screen Pick Friend Experience: Redesign the Pick Friend screen into a split layout displaying pet details side-by-side with choice cards. (why: Adoption step conversion drops to 60.9% with long decision times (89s median).)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Quick Pet Naming and Personality Selector Flow: Add a pet personality choice component to the adoption certificate screen to customize your companion's behavior early. (why: High drop-off at adoption (60.9%) and long time taken; adding immediate pet personalization boosts attachment.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Place Sign-In After Adoption Certificate: Reorder sign-in screen to take place right after completing the adoption certificate step, right before pet generation waiting. (why: Placing sign-in right after pet customization provides higher intent to create an account to save the custom pet.)
3: [home, notification] Desktop Spawn Readiness Sound Cue: Enable sound chime and audio cue on the waiting screen when pet rendering completes. (why: Waiting screen has a high mean duration (2336s), showing users leave the desktop app in the background during render.)
4: [home, wait_info] Time Estimate and Generation Step Counter: Add a visual step counter and estimated time remaining timer to the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting step mean time is over 38 minutes (2336s), creating uncertainty during pet generation.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Value Proposition Headline on Path Selection: Update choose_path screen headline and body to emphasize lightweight instant desktop companion setup. (why: Initial choose_path step loses 23.8% of users immediately.)
6: [sign_in, hint] Existing Pet Account Sync Guarantee Banner: Add a prominent account sync guarantee note to the sign_in screen clarifying that existing pets stay linked to the account. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Spotlight Card Layout on Story Screen: Update the story screen layout to spotlight mode with high-contrast mascot visuals. (why: 23.8% of users drop off at the initial onboarding story step.)

scores.note: Target step loses 39.1% of users, but layout redesigns historically show negative performance (-2.2%) and rollback risk.
Adoption has high drop-off, but adding extra flow components increases friction and requires full app release.
Reordering sign-in after adoption leverages high user intent and is proven effective (+5.5% measured).
High mean wait time (2336s) indicates app backgrounding; readiness notifications have proven +5.1% lift.
Addresses high background wait duration; wait info updates previously measured +4.0% lift.
Config-only copy change, but past copy updates have shown no clear positive effect.
Strong evidence from 8 support emails, though hint banners historically show minimal to slightly negative lift.
Requires layout redesign effort, but layout tweaks measured only +0.1% lift previously.
